description: This pie chart illustrates the proportional distribution of twelve distinct subject categories, likely representing the composition of a dataset. The chart does not utilize a separate legend; instead, each of the twelve slices is identified by a text label and a corresponding percentage positioned outside the pie, connected to its respective segment by a thin grey line. Moving clockwise from the top right, the categories and their values are as follows: a large blue slice for "AI/NLP Research" at 24.3%, a red slice for "Business" at 5.9%, a yellow-gold slice for "Geography" at 2.7%, a small dark green slice for "Math" at 1.2%, an orange slice for "Game&Anime" at 8.2%, a large teal slice for "Econ. & Fin." at 18.4%, a light blue slice for "Science" at 6.7%, a light red slice for "Law" at 5.1%, a yellow slice for "History" at 8.2%, a light green slice for "Med & Health" at 6.7%, a peach slice for "Pet & Animal" at 5.5%, and a light cyan slice for "Daily Life" at 7.1%. The segments are not arranged in any apparent sequential order based on size, and none of the slices are visually emphasized through explosion or offset techniques.
